title: 連接詞
point: 連接詞題先看空格後面：有主詞加動詞的完整子句就用連接詞，只有名詞或 V-ing 就用介系詞。接著再看前後句是讓步、原因、條件還是時間。
formula: 連接詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，主詞 + 動詞（連接詞後面接完整子句）

table.en: although / even though the price rose
table.rule: 連接詞，後面接主詞 + 動詞的子句

table.en: despite / in spite of the price increase
table.rule: 介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接子句

table.en: because the train was late / because of the late train
table.rule: because 接子句，because of 接名詞
unless 等於 if not，講未來時子句用現在式

table.en: provided that the budget is approved
table.rule: 條件連接詞，意思接近 if，後面接子句
一旦……就，講未來時子句用現在式，主句才用 will
while 表示「在……期間」，也可表示對比「然而」，後面接子句

examples: Although the hotel was fully booked, the travel agent found two rooms for us.
Although the deadline was tight, the design team finished the brochure on schedule.
story: Although the train to Taichung was delayed, Kevin arrived before the client meeting started.
Because the projector did not work, he presented the slides on his laptop.
The client agreed to sign the contract provided that deliveries begin in March.
Once the legal team reviews the terms, Kevin will send the final copy.

drills.prompt: Was Kevin late for the meeting?
drills.fix: Although 子句只交代火車誤點，主句 Kevin arrived before the meeting started 才是結果。

drills.prompt: When will Kevin send the final copy?
drills.fix: Once 後面的子句 the legal team reviews the terms 先發生，主句 will send 在它之後。

drills.prompt: ___ the rain was heavy, the shipment arrived on time.
drills.fix: 空格後面是完整子句 the rain was heavy，要用連接詞 although，despite 和 because of 只能接名詞。
